items.title: LangSmith BYOC is now available on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
items.en_title: LangSmith BYOC is now available on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith BYOC now runs on AWS (GA) and on Azure and Google Cloud (Beta), so your traces, evals, and agent deployments stay inside your own cloud account.

items.title: Le Chonk brings the brains. Studio puts it to work.
items.en_title: Le Chonk brings the brains. Studio puts it to work.
items.en_oneliner: Mistral Studio works with Le Chonk so enterprises can build and deploy agents, workflows, and apps faster while keeping full control of their models, data, and infrastructure.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.en_title: GPT-6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI's new cybersecurity model, GPT-6 Cyber, hunts for exploitable vulnerabilities and drafts fixes — trained to act only within authorized bounds.

items.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.en_title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.en_oneliner: Merge puts GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to work on code review and marketing support — and even lets AI help plan executive dinners and prep sales updates.

items.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
items.en_title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI has rolled out a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint alongside its National Community Compact, aiming to protect local resources, create jobs, and steer AI infrastructure toward responsible growth.

items.title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
items.en_title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
items.en_oneliner: Flipsnack aimed its ChatGPT Ads at getting people to try the product, and signups climbed while the cost of each signup fell.

items.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
items.en_title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
items.en_oneliner: Phonon TTS brings high-quality speech synthesis on-device with leading benchmark results, suited to latency- and privacy-sensitive scenarios.

items.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
items.en_title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
items.en_oneliner: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is building AI workflows that let portfolio managers weigh competing research views and take a closer look at investment risk.

items.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
items.en_title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
items.en_oneliner: Feed it any document and get structured fields back as JSON, a fast way to turn unstructured material into usable data.

items.title: Why human insight is a strategic advantage for building better agents
items.en_title: Why human insight is a strategic advantage for building better agents
items.en_oneliner: The post sets out three principles for human-in-the-loop work and argues that keeping people in the review loop is essential once agents run in production.
